preconditions.description: The number of integers n is between 1 and 400,000 inclusive.
Each integer a_i is between 1 and 10^9 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The total number of cells x in the largest beautiful rectangle is between 1 and n inclusive.
The sizes of the rectangle are p rows and q columns, such that the total number of cells is x.

postconditions.expression: all(len(set(row)) == q for row in rectangle)
postconditions.description: Each row in the rectangle contains all unique elements.

postconditions.expression: all(len(set(col)) == p for col in zip(*rectangle))
postconditions.description: Each column in the rectangle contains all unique elements.
